title: Meetings
description: All meetings booked from cold calls
metaTitle: Meetings — Booked from Cold Calls | Ringee
metaDescription: View and manage all meetings booked during cold calls. Track upcoming meetings, review past bookings, and stay on top of your pipeline.

availability.title: Booking availability
availability.description: Choose the recurring hours when Ringee may book meetings and how many people may share each time.
availability.agentHint: AI voice agents use these Ringee hours directly. Google Calendar is optional and only syncs a copy of a booking when connected.
availability.capacityHint: The time stays available until this many active meetings overlap it.
availability.unlimitedHint: Ringee may book any number of people at the same time in this window.

validation.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
validation.overlap: This window overlaps another window on the same day.
validation.capacity: Enter between 1 and 10,000, or choose unlimited.

empty.title: No meetings scheduled
empty.description: Once you book a meeting it will show up here.
empty.noMeetingsDescription: Book your first meeting during a call. Every booked meeting shows up here.

integrations.title: Calendar Integrations
integrations.description: Optionally connect an external calendar to sync meetings booked in Ringee and create video links.
integrations.connectFailed: Failed to connect calendar. Please try again.
integrations.howItWorksPrefix: When connected, Ringee creates an external calendar event with a
integrations.howItWorksSuffix: link. Without an integration, meetings and availability continue to work in Ringee.

google.name: Google Calendar
google.description: Sync meetings with Google Calendar and auto-create Google Meet links.

microsoft.name: Microsoft Outlook
microsoft.description: Sync meetings with Outlook Calendar and auto-create Teams links.

booking.emailRequired: Please provide an email for the contact
booking.availabilityFailed: Could not check Ringee availability. Try again.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Every workspace has one global calendar. Add more when different agents need their own hours, time zone or capacity.
calendars.agentHint: Ringee is the only source of availability. Google is optional and only receives a copy of a booking that already exists here.
calendars.agentsUsing: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
calendars.name: Name
calendars.timezoneHint: The zone the hours below are in. It wins over an agent's own time zone.
calendars.archivedHint: Archived. Its meetings and history are kept, but it takes no new bookings and is not offered to agents.
calendars.connectionHint: Where bookings made here are copied. It never decides which times Ringee offers, and a calendar with no connection books normally.
calendars.externalLoadFailed: Could not read the connected account's calendars. Reconnect it and try again.
calendars.agentsEmpty: No agent books on this calendar yet.
calendars.agentsGlobalEmpty: Every agent with no calendar of its own books here, along with the dialer and campaigns.

externalSync.bookingSafe: The meeting is confirmed in Ringee. Only the copy on the connected calendar is affected.
externalSync.retryFailed: The external event could not be created.
